The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide.

Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.

Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.

Fresha ’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.

The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Executive to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha 's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha 's expansion.

You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

Join Collibra's Sales team as a Senior Account Executive, Financial Services - East Coast
Collibra is the Data Intelligence company, helping organizations maximize the value of their data through trusted, governed, and meaningful data access — empowering many of the world's leading financial institutions to scale data-driven decision-making while meeting the most demanding regulatory and compliance requirements.
As a Senior Account Executive within Collibra's Financial Services vertical, you will spearhead a premier portfolio of strategic East Coast accounts, ranging from global investment firms to some of the nation's largest commercial banking institutions.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and Financial Services leaders, navigating them through the complexities of data and AI governance to unlock a distinct competitive advantage.

Your mission is to build brand authority and serve as a Data Intelligence visionary across the entire customer lifecycle, driving demand, accelerating adoption, and leading expansion efforts within a territory of top-tier incumbents and high-growth financial prospects.
Senior Account Executives, Financial Services at Collibra are responsible for
Prospecting for net new FinServ accounts, greenfield building, and developing relationships with existing customers to maintain active deal pipeline and ideal quota coverage in your territory.
Managing and creating demand for expansion on existing FinServ customers to widen the footprint of Collibra within these accounts.
Managing complex deal cycles, from lead origination to stakeholder mapping, through negotiation to close and expansion.
Successfully collaborating with customers, partners, and peers in a consultative sales process where you will identify value and ROI aligned to the specific data governance and compliance needs of financial institutions.
Reliable, accurate forecasting, with Salesforce updates reflective of real-time activity.
You have
At least 2–3 years of experience in Data Management, Data/AI Governance, or FinServ technology sales, with deep familiarity with the regulatory landscapes and data complexities inherent to the financial sector.
A proven ability to originate and lead complex, value-based sales cycles, navigating multiple technical and business stakeholders to secure both net-new business and strategic expansions.
A successful history of developing high-profile, long-term relationships with C-level buyers and stakeholders across the financial services ecosystem.
Consistently achieved or overachieved your SaaS sales quota.
Managed consultative sales processes, utilizing established sales methodologies to drive predictable, impact-driven outcomes.
Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience.
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
You are
Composed and resourceful, remaining focused and effective in fast-paced, evolving environments.
Known for your integrity and a trusted advisor approach to the customer journey.
A precise communicator and persuasive negotiator who can translate technical data governance concepts into compelling business outcomes for executive leadership
Adaptive, accountable, and execution-oriented.
Proud of your work, aim for excellence in every interaction, and are flexible to travel as required to support your accounts.
Measures of success
Within your first month, you have completed onboarding, connected with your team members as well as with your functional peers.
Within your third month, you will be in the midst of building a pipeline of business within your assigned FinServ accounts and territory.
Within your sixth month, you will have a solid foundation of prospective FinServ clients who you will be close to closing, and will be well-positioned as a trusted advisor in the Data Intelligence market for Financial Services companies.

The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .
We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category.

As we accelerate Diligent's presence across EMEA's specialist services markets, we're looking for a driven, commercially sharp sales professional who can win and grow with senior buyers in a governed, compliance-driven world.
This is a rare opportunity to join Specialty Markets, a high-growth EMEA division serving the firms that manage governance, entities, risk and audit on behalf of their clients. You'll own a defined, high-value territory with a clear mandate: grow net-new revenue and expand within an established base of Diligent relationships.
If you know how to sell complex, multi-stakeholder software into professional and regulated services firms – and can get credible with their leaders fast – this role was built for you.
The Market You'll Sell Into
You'll sell to professional and regulated services firms that deliver governance, entity, risk, compliance and audit work on behalf of their clients. In practice that spans fund administrators, corporate service providers, management companies (ManCos / AIFMs), law firms, private equity and venture capital firms, trust & fiduciary services, risk advisers, and audit & advisory firms.
This isn't back-office compliance – it's a revenue-generating service line they deliver to their own clients. Diligent's platform underpins how they run and scale that work, which makes us central to how they win, serve and grow their client base, not just how they stay compliant.
Jurisdictions: this is a single, flexible mandate that can be run across any of our key offshore and onshore markets – including the Channel Islands, Luxembourg, Ireland, the UK, Cayman, BVI, Bermuda, the Isle of Man and the Middle East.

Own the full commercial cycle across your patch – from prospecting and pipeline generation through to close and upsell – working both new-logo acquisition and account expansion.
Use your network and market fluency to open doors quickly, run complex multi-stakeholder deals independently, and partner with Diligent's broader field sales team to shape our continued growth in this segment.
Build credible, senior-level relationships across your markets – understanding the governance, risk, compliance and regulatory pressures that drive buying decisions.
Consistently build and manage accurate pipeline and forecasts in Salesforce.
Required Experience & Skills
7+ years selling SaaS as an Account Executive, Account Manager, Sales Manager or Channel Manager, with a consistent track record of attaining quota.
Track record selling complex, multi-stakeholder SaaS into professional or regulated services firms – governance, risk, compliance, entity, legal or audit/analytics software. Direct experience in fund services, corporate services or a comparable regulated market (risk advisory, audit & advisory, legal) is a strong plus, but we care more that you can get credible with senior buyers in a governed, compliance-driven world quickly.
Comfortable operating where regulation and compliance drive the buying decision, and able to speak to those pressures with authority.
Strong sales acumen – you navigate tough conversations and turn them into a win-win.
Excellent communication and influencing skills across written, verbal and live presentations.
Experience with Salesforce.

At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions.

It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. Developing business opportunities via the partner channel, including creating and implementing marketing plans and collaborating with other departments to identify new business prospects.
Actively supporting our partners with lead qualification and leveraging your own closing skills to help secure partner deals.
Conducting sales workshops, training sessions, end-user webinars, and customer presentations to educate partners and close deals.
Acquiring new partners and expanding the partner network.

You have excellent IT skills and the ability to competently demonstrate software functions and their benefits.

**Description de l'entreprise**
Unser Auftraggeber ist einer der führenden Microsoft\-Partner im DACH\-Raum und digitalisiert Geschäftsmodelle mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 und der Power Platform. So werden Unternehmen und Organisationen sowie Kundenbeziehungen gezielt zu entwickelt, um Prozesse zu vereinfachen und Entscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen.
Für den weiteren Ausbau eines erfolgreichen Beratungs\- und Digitalisierungsgeschäfts suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Vertriebspersönlichkeit mit fundierter CRM\-Expertise. In dieser Rolle liegt der Fokus vollständig auf der Gewinnung neuer Kunden und Projekte im Bereich Customer Relationship Management.
**Description du poste**
* Neukundengewinnung und Geschäftsausbau
* Sie identifizieren und erschliessen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten bei mittelständischen Unternehmen verschiedener Branchen und bauen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.
* Dabei nutzen Sie Ihr persönliches Netzwerk, Marktaktivitäten, Partnerkontakte sowie qualifizierte Leads aus Vertriebs\- und Marketinginitiativen.
* Steuerung des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses
* Von der ersten Bedarfsermittlung über die Ausarbeitung von Lösungsansätzen bis hin zu Vertragsverhandlungen begleiten Sie Verkaufschancen eigenständig und übernehmen die Verantwortung für den erfolgreichen Abschluss.
* Sie koordinieren sowohl Direktgeschäfte als auch komplexe Ausschreibungen.
* Sie analysieren die geschäftlichen Herausforderungen Ihrer Kunden in den Bereichen Vertrieb, Marketing und Kundenservice und entwickeln passgenaue Digitalisierungs\- und CRM\-Konzepte.
* Moderne Technologien, Datenstrategien und KI\-basierte Anwendungen setzen Sie gezielt ein, um Mehrwert und Effizienzsteigerungen aufzuzeigen.
* Für Workshops, Präsentationen, Demonstrationen und Angebotsausarbeitungen arbeiten Sie eng mit Consulting\- und Solution\-Teams zusammen.
* Sie koordinieren die beteiligten Spezialisten und sorgen für einen professionellen und überzeugenden Marktauftritt.
* Sie entwickeln die Zusammenarbeit mit Technologiepartnern sowie relevanten Marktteilnehmern weiter und identifizieren gemeinsame Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
* Sie steuern Ihre Verkaufspipeline aktiv, pflegen relevante Informationen in den CRM\-Systemen und erstellen fundierte Umsatzprognosen für das Management.
* Sie erkennen Trends, Kundenbedürfnisse und Marktveränderungen frühzeitig und bringen Ihre Erkenntnisse aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Angeboten, Vertriebsmassnahmen und Marktstrategien ein.
**Profil recherché**
* Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertrieb von beratungsintensiven Software\-, Technologie\- oder Transformationsprojekten.
* Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Akquisition und dem Abschluss komplexer Kundenprojekte.
